stories.headline: Perplexity launches Teammates, always-on AI agents for ongoing work
stories.what_happened: On November 5, 2026, Perplexity launched Teammates, persistent AI agents that own ongoing roles such as campaign management, bug triage or market research. Each teammate runs on Perplexity Computer with its own isolated desktop and browser, inherits existing projects, skills and memory, coordinates other agents, and can message humans in Slack. Available as a research preview for Max subscribers ($200/month) on the web.
stories.why_it_matters: Shifts agents from one-shot task runners to always-on digital coworkers with role persistence and proactive monitoring, competing directly with OpenAI and Anthropic enterprise agent offerings.
